title: Design: Work orders list shows the Internal and No Charge badges
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have one open internal work order and one open no-charge work order.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow1-01-01-work-orders-list.png, iwo-happy-11-11-work-orders-list.png, iwo-components-02-wo-list-artboard-v6.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The internal row shows the "Internal" badge and the no-charge row the "No Charge" badge, in the Status column next to the status.
  • The two badges are in different styles (No Charge is not drawn the same as Internal).
  • The "Total price" column (the last column) reads "No Charge" on both rows.
  • In the Status column the status and the badge stay on one line, with nothing cut off.

Step 2:

  • Nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off, and every label stays on its line as in the 1440 pixel view.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R10: “The work orders list shows the badge in the status column for internal and no-charge work orders in every tab, in the Tech View display and on the mobile card.”
  • S2-R3: “The work order header shows one badge next to the status: "Internal" for an internal work order, "No Charge" for a no-charge work order (a different style from Internal), in the desktop and the mobile header.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 1 · Create and close" / "Happy flow v6" / "Shared screens", boards "01 Work orders list" (Flow 1 · Create and close), "11 Work orders list" (Happy flow v6), "WO List Artboard v6" (Shared screens).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow1-01-01-work-orders-list.png
  • iwo-happy-11-11-work-orders-list.png
  • iwo-components-02-wo-list-artboard-v6.png

The design's own words:

  • “Internal”
  • “No Charge”

Difference: the design puts the badge after the customer name (IWO-D35) and draws No Charge in the Internal style (IWO-D15), both settled by S2-R10 and S2-R3. The column label is the screen's "Total price" (IWO-D55); the library's Status column is 120 px wide (library rule L26).
